snippet.title: a permanent echo - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
a permanent echo is a game about investigation and deduction. About piecing together how we will remember - and judge -  the decisions that shape our future.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3727200/a_permanent_echo/

Dive into the mind of Subject 2184. Reconstruct the conspiracy that doomed Europe’s solution to climate disaster. Explore a near future and decide the shape of its history. Assess a life lived between idealism and turmoil. Ask yourself: How do societies change? 

Learn more at https://apermanentecho.com
